revision_disclosure: Observed V1 JAYME DeepSeek-v4 call12 and Qwen3.5 call13 length responses before this revision. V1 adapter incorrectly required stop-only; official query never checks finish_reason. Uniform V2 removes that extra gate for all 24 jobs to restore original author continuation, without changing prompt, model, temperature, max_tokens=4096, inputs, complete history, or safe data parsing. No Gold scores were used for this correction.
method_name: Official LLMCluster flow with registered input/backend adapter
native_tail_rule: Merge remaining 1..4 reports into the preceding final batch
dialogue: Full prior system/user/assistant messages retained; no truncation or summary compression
input: Exact frozen descriptions; stable 1-based native IDs mapped to original source IDs
native_correction: Preserved: cross-cluster duplicate stays in largest cluster; all omitted IDs appended together as one cluster
invalid_terminal: After native correction, any duplicate/out-of-range/incomplete population fails; no extra singletons or semantic repair
native_summary: Required final call; uses original dialogue and does not change partition; cost counted separately
failure: One stored attempt; wrong model, HTTP/invalid envelope failure remain failed; no resampling. Usable nonempty assistant content is continued regardless of finish_reason, as in the official query; all finish reasons and length counts are retained.
migration: Only archived V1 evidence at the exact canonical wire and dialogue position may import. Preserve original request, response, and status bindings. HTTP failures and uncertain dispatched calls block re-query. A FAILED V1 result can only import when HTTP200, usable correct-model content/usage and length establish the removed stop-only rejection. V1 files are never changed.
accounting: V1 imported responses retain original incurred token usage but count zero new V2 attempts. Total unique original dialogue positions remain 222; V1 and V2 costs are not double-counted.
resume: Replay exact committed dialogue; reject changed requests or uncertain dispatched calls
evaluation: Separate offline strict single-label scoring; no native Gold/BERTScore evaluation in online worker
budget_scope: 222 native dialogue calls, not atomic-pair queries and not added to the 288-job matrix
interpretation: Native full-flow baseline versus AQCC conditional frozen-start iteration; endpoint quality is not automatically equal-cost superiority
upstream_snapshot: The collected ClusterManager source and original prompt are supplied in code/llmcluster/upstream.
